name: dolidob-us-paycheck-tax-data
title: Dolidob U.S. paycheck and tax data
description: Take-home pay by state and salary, Ohio municipal income tax rates and federal tax brackets, from the data behind the dolidob.com calculators. Every official figure is checked against its government source.

resources.name: take-home-pay-by-state-2026
resources.title: U.S. take-home pay by state and salary, 2026
resources.description: Federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, state income tax, state employee contributions and take-home pay for 50 states and the District of Columbia, salaries from $30,000 to $250,000 in $5,000 steps. Single filer, paid every two weeks (26 paychecks), no 401(k) or pre-tax benefits, each state's default withholding allowances, no city or county tax. Computed with the same code as the dolidob.com Take-Home Pay Calculator.

sources.title: Official figures used, each with its government source
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (2026 federal brackets and standard deduction)

resources.citation: Dolidob, "U.S. take-home pay by state and salary, 2026" (version 2026.2, updated 2026-11-19), https://dolidob.com/data/take-home-pay-by-state-2026.csv. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

fields.name: take_home_per_biweekly_paycheck

resources.name: us-local-income-tax-rates
resources.title: U.S. city and county income taxes on wages
resources.description: Every city and county wage tax used by the dolidob.com paycheck calculators, from official state and city sources: Michigan cities (Detroit, Grand Rapids), Indiana counties, Maryland counties and Baltimore City, New York City and Yonkers, Philadelphia, and Ohio municipalities. Rates as the agencies publish them; the method column notes brackets, tiers and surcharges.

sources.title: Each row's source_url: the agency publication the rate was checked against

resources.citation: Dolidob, "U.S. city and county income taxes on wages" (version 2026.1, updated 2026-11-19), https://dolidob.com/data/us-local-income-tax-rates.csv. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
